title: SR-2.09 The coming-soon provider: build it or stop showing it
request: Closes G29: The site shows a third cloud AI provider as coming soon; nothing in the product repo supports it. Repository: memev. Depends on contracts: none.

tasks.title: Decision and delivery
requirements: a decision record says whether the coming-soon provider is supported; if yes, a connector with a test; if no, the site drops it (SR-6.06)

if the decision is build, the connector has a test that runs it against a recorded fixture of the provider's API; if drop, no status-table row is left for a provider without a connector, so the site's claims check (SR-6.10) fails on any page that still shows it

criteria.statement: The decision is build or drop

SR-2.09 outcome: with the decision record saying build, the provider's connector test runs against its recorded fixture; with drop, docs/status.json holds no provider row without a connector in src/cli/clients.mjs; a fixture status row for a provider with no connector fails under drop

verifier.cmd: out=$(node --test --test-reporter=tap --test-name-pattern='^SR-2.09 outcome' test/clients.test.mjs 2>&1); rc=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -30; [ $rc -eq 0 ] && printf '%s\n' "$out" | awk -v pat='^SR-2.09 outcome$' 'BEGIN { n = split(pat, alt, "|") } function flush(  i) { if (cand != "") for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (cand ~ alt[i]) hit[i] = 1; cand = "" } /^[[:space:]]*(not )?ok [0-9]+ - / { flush(); name = $0; sub(/^[[:space:]]*(not )?ok [0-9]+ - /, "", name); if ($0 ~ /^[[:space:]]*ok / && name !~ /# (SKIP|TODO)/ && name !~ /\.test\.m?js$/) cand = name; next } /^[[:space:]]*type: .suite./ { cand = "" } END { flush(); for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (!hit[i]) exit 1; exit 0 }'

stop_rules: If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
If the work needs a path outside scope: STOP and ask the owner to amend the contract. Never widen scope silently.
